# AWS — AWS Activate Credits

AWS promotional credits by tier: up to $200,000 for pre-Series B startups applying with an Activate Provider's Org ID (Activate Portfolio), up to $5,000 for self-funded founders, and an invite-only AI tier above that.

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Activate Founders (self-funded) | $5,000 | *Start with $1,000 USD in Activate Credits. Select participants may qualify for additional credits up to $5,000 | No partner needed |
| Activate Portfolio (pre-Series B) | $200,000 | *You must have an Organization ID (Org ID) from your Activate Provider, such as an accelerator, angel investor, and venture capital firm | A partner code is required |
| AWS Credits for AI Startups | — | Invite only for startups ready to scale post Activate Portfolio | _Not stated by the vendor_ |


> **Stacking:** Applicants must be "either new to Activate Credits or requesting more credits than previously received"; prior recipients can request an increment rather than a fresh full grant.
